questions.text: PAYG Pricing & Terms Transparency - SSA: Provide complete disclosure of Pay-As-You-Go terms: (1) Total Cost of Ownership (cash price vs total PAYG payments); (2) Interest rate/finance charges (implied APR); (3) Payment schedule (daily/weekly/monthly amounts); (4) Deposit requirements; (5) Ownership transfer terms (when does user own system?); (6) Penalty fees (late payment fees, unlock fees); (7) Repossession terms (when is system removed?).
questions.evidence_required: PAYG contract templates, Pricing sheets showing TCO, APR calculations, Repossession policies, User communication materials
questions.africa_specific_notes: Users often don't understand they are taking a loan. Implied interest rates can be high. TCO must be clear. Ownership transfer often confused (lease-to-own vs perpetual lease).

questions.text: Energy Tariff & Billing Transparency (Mini-Grids): For mini-grids, disclose tariff structure: (1) Cost per kWh (vs national grid, vs diesel); (2) Connection fees; (3) Fixed monthly charges; (4) Tariff approval status (approved by regulator?); (5) Tariff adjustment mechanism (inflation, fuel costs); (6) Prepaid meter logic (how is credit deducted?); (7) Cross-subsidies (do commercial users subsidize households?).
questions.evidence_required: Tariff sheets, Regulator approval letters, Billing logic documentation, Meter calibration reports, User billing examples
questions.africa_specific_notes: Mini-grid tariffs usually higher than national grid (friction point). Users need to understand why. Prepaid meters standard. Regulator approval critical.

questions.text: Remote Monitoring & Control Logic: Explain remote monitoring capabilities: (1) What data is monitored (voltage, usage, location)?; (2) Remote switch logic (under what conditions is power cut?); (3) Data transmission frequency; (4) User visibility (can user see their own data?); (5) Tamper detection logic (what triggers a tamper alert?); (6) Firmware update process; (7) Privacy implications of monitoring.
questions.evidence_required: Monitoring system specs, Remote switch protocols, User dashboard demos, Tamper detection logic, Privacy policies
questions.africa_specific_notes: Remote monitoring standard for PAYG. Privacy concerns (location tracking). Users should know if they are being monitored. Remote switch = enforcement mechanism.

questions.text: Carbon Credit & Data Monetization Transparency: Disclose non-payment revenue streams: (1) Carbon credit generation (does company sell credits based on user system?); (2) Benefit sharing (do users get lower prices due to credits?); (3) Data monetization (selling usage data to investors/researchers); (4) Consent for monetization (did user agree?); (5) Value reporting (how much value generated per user?); (6) Ownership of environmental attributes (who owns the carbon offset?).
questions.evidence_required: Carbon credit policy, User consent forms, Benefit sharing model
questions.africa_specific_notes: Carbon finance is growing. Users generate the value but often don't know or benefit.

questions.text: User Energy Consumption Visibility: Provide users with consumption data: (1) Remaining credit display (days/kWh); (2) Current load/usage display; (3) Battery state of charge indicator; (4) Solar generation indicator; (5) Historical usage data (via app or USSD); (6) Low credit alerts (SMS/visual); (7) Overload warnings.
questions.evidence_required: User interface screenshots/photos, USSD menu trees, Alert system documentation, User manual explaining indicators
questions.africa_specific_notes: Users need to know 'how many hours left'. Battery indicators often confusing. USSD checks common. Low credit alerts prevent blackout.

questions.text: System Health & Maintenance Visibility: Alert users to system health issues: (1) Panel cleaning reminders; (2) Battery health status; (3) Fault codes/indicators (simple to understand); (4) Maintenance schedules (for mini-grids); (5) Technician arrival tracking; (6) Ticket status tracking (for repairs); (7) End-of-life warnings (battery replacement needed).
questions.evidence_required: Fault code list, Maintenance notification system, Ticket tracking interface, End-of-life policy
questions.africa_specific_notes: Panel cleaning often neglected (dust). Fault codes must be simple (icons/colors). Users need to know when battery dying.

questions.text: Energy Usage Data Privacy: Protect user energy data: (1) Data collection scope (usage patterns, location, payment history); (2) Third-party sharing (credit bureaus, government, investors); (3) Anonymization protocols; (4) Data retention policies; (5) User consent mechanisms; (6) Cross-border data transfer (server location); (7) Data security measures.
questions.evidence_required: Data privacy policy, Third-party sharing agreements, Consent forms, Data security certifications
questions.africa_specific_notes: Energy usage data reveals lifestyle/wealth. Payment history used for credit scoring. Data often stored on servers outside Africa (sovereignty issues).

questions.text: Credit Assessment Data Transparency: If energy payments build credit history: (1) Reporting to credit bureaus (which ones?); (2) Positive vs negative reporting (only defaults or also good payments?); (3) Credit score impact explanation; (4) Data accuracy dispute mechanism; (5) User consent for credit reporting; (6) Alternative credit scoring methodology; (7) Data portability (can credit history be used elsewhere?).
questions.evidence_required: Credit reporting agreements, User consent forms, Dispute resolution procedures, Credit scoring methodology
questions.africa_specific_notes: PAYG often first formal credit history. Reporting to credit bureaus (CRBs) growing. Negative reporting can harm unbanked users. Transparency essential.

questions.text: User Manuals & Guides - Low Literacy Context: Provide accessible documentation: (1) Pictorial/visual guides (installation, operation, troubleshooting); (2) Local language manuals; (3) Video tutorials (shareable via WhatsApp/Bluetooth); (4) Voice instructions (IVR or embedded in device); (5) Laminated quick-start guides (durability); (6) Agent training materials (to explain to users); (7) Safety warnings (battery safety, electrical shock).
questions.evidence_required: User manual samples (visual/local language), Video tutorial links, Safety warning labels, Agent training aids
questions.africa_specific_notes: Text-heavy manuals useless for many. Visuals essential. Local languages mandatory. Safety warnings critical (lithium batteries).

questions.text: Contract & Warranty Documentation: Ensure contracts are understandable: (1) Simple language contracts (lease-to-own); (2) Warranty terms clearly stated (what is covered/excluded); (3) Verbal explanation confirmation (agent checklist); (4) Digital copy access (SMS link); (5) Physical copy provision; (6) Cancellation rights explanation; (7) Contact info for support clearly visible.
questions.evidence_required: Contract templates, Warranty cards, Agent explanation checklists, Cancellation policies
questions.africa_specific_notes: Contracts often signed without understanding. Warranty terms often misunderstood (e.g., tampering voids warranty). Verbal explanation by agent is key.

questions.text: Customer Support Channels - Off-Grid: Provide accessible support: (1) Toll-free phone line; (2) USSD help menu; (3) WhatsApp support; (4) Local agent network (in-person); (5) SMS support; (6) Response time SLAs; (7) Language support availability.
questions.evidence_required: Support channel list, Call center metrics, SLA documentation, Language support matrix
questions.africa_specific_notes: Phone/Agent support primary. WhatsApp growing. Toll-free essential (users have no airtime). Local language support critical.

questions.text: Service Alert Communication: Proactively communicate service issues: (1) Planned maintenance alerts (mini-grids); (2) System fault alerts (PAYG); (3) Payment reminders (before cutoff); (4) Tariff change notifications; (5) Weather warnings (protect panels); (6) Technician arrival notifications; (7) Complaint resolution updates.
questions.evidence_required: SMS alert templates, Notification logs, Payment reminder schedule, Complaint tracking system
questions.africa_specific_notes: Payment reminders prevent blackout. Maintenance alerts manage expectations. Complaint resolution updates build trust.

scoring_notes: Layer 2 (Transparency) for Energy in SSA: Pricing transparency (TCO) for PAYG is paramount. Users must understand they are entering a financial contract. Visual documentation and local language support are mandatory for inclusivity.
